questions.prediction: Before executing parser.py, predict success/failure on empty, one-entry and markers files. Separate prediction from later observed exception, preserve parser-original.py and first failure.txt.
questions.reduce: Preserve each candidate reproducer and observed failure. Distinguish the same loop-guard failure from a different earlier envelope failure. Justify why a smaller valid file cannot trigger the same failure.
questions.trace: Preserve a value trace from input length/count/payload through cursor, end and next entry, marking the first false bound. State the cause as a falsifiable claim and retain competing explanations.
questions.repair: Before editing, predict the effect of a narrow patch on empty, minimal, original and malformed inputs. Save repaired source and learner regression tests plus failure/checker feedback in new records.
questions.handoff: Preserve the patch rationale, original and repaired results, regression tests, valid-output comparison, residual risks and assistance. Export/resume records byte-for-byte; make no claim beyond evidence.
